# v0.1.0 — Initial release

Release draft for publishing the "Software Intake Gatekeeper" GitHub Action to the Marketplace.

Tag: v0.1.0

## Summary

Evidence-first intake checks for third-party apps and binaries: CycloneDX SBOM generation, OSV known-vulnerabilities lookup, Electron fuse and webPreferences hardening, SARIF output and an APPROVE/REVIEW/REJECT policy gate.

This release packages the existing composite Action (action.yml) and the Python CLI into a release suitable for Marketplace publishing.

## Highlights

- Composite Action: action.yml present at repository root (uses actions/setup-python and a local Python package)
- Python package: src/intake_gatekeeper, entrypoint `intake-gatekeeper` (pyproject.toml v0.1.0)
- Outputs SARIF, CycloneDX SBOM, and a JSON report with decision (approve/review/reject)

## Installation (example workflow)

```yaml
name: Scan third-party app
on: [push]
jobs:
  scan_app:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run intake gatekeeper
        uses: Sushant-Nemade/software-intake-gatekeeper@v0.1.0
        with:
          path: ./path/to/app
          osv: true
          fail-on: reject
          output-dir: intake-gatekeeper-reports
```

## Release notes

Initial public release of the GitHub Action and Python tooling. Adds SBOM generation, OSV vulnerability lookups, SARIF output, and policy-based decision gate for intake workflows.
